pivot_note: Viv's pivot (the spine at the back of the head); the same pivot as every girl sheet
lower_note: the boots are not in this sheet: draw Viv's exported lower frame given in each frame's `lower` under it (frames 0-1 = girl_walk_lower 0 / 4, the walk's contact steps (her footstep frames); frame 2 = girl_stand_lower)
draw_order: draw order: the frame's lower, then this sheet frame i (torso, left arm, right arm, flashlight over the hand, cap). The whole sprite turns as one (MOVEMENT_PLAN 1)
state: flashlight raised, on (always: one carry state, as ranger_stand)
turn_note: the game turns the whole sprite toward the noise (240 deg/s, MOVEMENT_PLAN 3 / 6) while frames 0-1 play: the boot shuffle MOVEMENT_PLAN 2 gives standing turns. Turns over ~60 deg take longer than frames 0-1 (260 ms): repeat frames 0-1 until the rotation ends, then play frame 2 (the settle). Frame 2 equals ranger_stand, so the clip ends in stand without a pop; to walk toward the noise, enter ranger_walk on frame 2 or 6 (passing). Works for either direction, no flip
flashlight_note: his light is session 04's flashlight cone, from flashlight_tip along flashlight_angle_deg (deg out from straight ahead = down the sheet); steady through the turn (the sprite's rotation turns it)
head_note: the cap is drawn in the sheet; head_center includes the walk's head_offset on frames 0-1
sound_note: a soft footstep on each shuffle step (frames 0 and 1)
